notes:
- Server browser: PLAY > FIND GAME lists games being hosted, so you can just click JOIN. Games on your
  network show up by themselves; internet games show up in the online list (when the host has
  "List online" on). JOIN BY IP is still there.
- Hosting opens your router's port automatically when the router allows it (UPnP); the lobby says if
  it worked or if you need to forward UDP port 24565 yourself.
- Le Chonk is chonkier: a much rounder, wider body that sags onto the floor with belly rolls, and a
  bigger jiggle on every bounce.
- Longshot scope: zoomed in, it's the blacked-out scope view again. In hip fire you can now see through
  the scope's eyepiece on the gun (it shows the magnified view).
